name: B10-0253/2025 (PfE) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling on China to free the 11th Panchen Lama, a Tibetan Buddhist leader taken away by Chinese authorities in 1995 at age six and not seen since. It also asks China to release other arrested Tibetan leaders and to stop restricting religious practice, including monitoring and detaining religious leaders and controlling monasteries and Catholic bishops.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position.
- It concerns China's treatment of Tibetan religious leaders and believers.
- Parliament sends the text to the relevant parties; China is not bound by it.
